description_en: You can invoke ListRealtimeSkillGroupStates to obtain the real-time skill group status report for a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListRealtimeSkillGroupStates获取指定实例下实时技能组状态报表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-realtime-skill-group-states --skill-group-id-list skillgroup1@ccc-test_,_skillgroup2@ccc-test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id ccc-test --media-type AUDIO --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRealtimeSkillGroupStates

parameters.description_en: List of skill group IDs for which data is queried. If not specified, all skill groups under the current instance are queried. The format is a JSON array string, with each array element being a skill group ID.
